adjudication_protocols_overview.protocol_guided_crosscheck: Waiting-period confirmation (40 seeds) and extension (24 seeds) cross-check with explicit domain task instructions (including pa_h716 30d/90d organ split note).
adjudication_protocols_overview.pure_verbatim_adjudication: Zero-hint verbatim-only adjudication (evaluated on all 40 confirmation seeds in `ccf_a_pure_verbatim_adjudications.jsonl` and all 24 non-waiting-period seeds in `ccf_a_raw_clause_adjudications.jsonl`), showing ONLY verbatim contract excerpts and universal 3-class task definitions without any compiled rule hints or threshold tables.

metric_definitions.binary_usability_kappa: Agreement on binary usability vote I(policy_identified AND sentence_complete AND decision == seed_gold).
metric_definitions.three_way_semantic_label_kappa: Agreement directly on the 3-class semantic decision label in {ELIGIBLE, EXCLUDED, CLARIFY}, computed without referencing seed_gold.

between_seed_cluster_means_n24.note: Between-seed correlation over N=24 seed means is underpowered and confounded by cross-policy baseline retrieveability differences; the within-seed fixed-effects analysis isolates the effect of rewrite lexical novelty holding the seed/policy fixed.

novelty_vs_retriever_discrimination_corr.finding: Across raw pooled usable insurance queries (N=421), clause-body lexical novelty (1 - kappa_2) correlates positively with the dense-minus-lexical retrieval gap (Pearson r = 0.0973, p = 0.0461; Spearman rho = 0.1631, p = 0.000784). After deduplicating shared queries across methods to N=245 unique (seed, question) pairs (Pearson r = 0.1182, 24-seed cluster bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0525, 0.2836]; Spearman rho = 0.2109), between-seed cluster means (N=24, r = 0.1022, p = 0.6346) and within-seed demeaned variations (within-seed r = 0.0983, exact within-seed permutation p = 0.2239776) remain positive in direction but do not reach seed-clustered statistical significance, so we report the novelty-to-gap association as an exploratory observation rather than a headline claim.

ins_deductible_pa2651.title: 平安安医保（易核版）医疗保险（免赔额与给付比例条款）
ins_deductible_pa2651.clause_text: 【原文第17页 1.6 保险金计算方法】一般医疗保险金=（有效医疗费用-年免赔额）×给付比例。（2）若被保险人以参加社会医疗保险身份投保，但未以参加社会医疗保险身份结算的，给付比例为60%；其他情形下，给付比例为100%。（4）根据上述公式计算所得金额小于或等于零时，本主险合同需要给付的保险金金额为零。【原文第47页 附录2 计划表】一般医疗保险金年免赔额：计划一为1万元（10000元），计划二为2万元（20000元），计划三为3万元（30000元）。

ins_deductible_pa1073.title: 平安i药保B款特药费用医疗保险（特药给付比例与分档限额条款）
ins_deductible_pa1073.clause_text: 【原文第3–4页 1.3.2–1.3.4 恶性肿瘤特种药品费用保险金】被保险人经医院确诊初次发生恶性肿瘤，自确诊之日起1年为用药期；我们对被保险人在用药期外发生的恶性肿瘤特种药品费用不承担给付保险金的责任。对用药期内实际发生的合理特药费用，按以下给付比例给付：（1）基本医疗保险目录外恶性肿瘤特种药品：给付比例100%；（2）基本医疗保险目录内恶性肿瘤特种药品：已从基本医疗保险获得费用补偿的，给付比例100%；以有基本医疗保险身份参保，但未从基本医疗保险获得费用补偿的，给付比例60%。累计给付金额以投保档次对应的保险金额为限，累计给付达到保险金额时本合同终止。【原文第9页 附录1 计划表】保险金额（给付限额）：一档10万元，二档20万元，三档50万元；起付线0元。

ins_hospital_pa2650.title: 平安e生保（悦享版）医疗保险（医院普通部范围与住院前后30日门急诊条款）
ins_hospital_pa2650.clause_text: 【原文第3–4页及第49页 1.5.2 一般医疗保险金、脚注3医院、脚注4住院、附录2】（1）医院范围：指中华人民共和国境内（港、澳、台地区除外）合法经营的二级以上（含二级）公立医院普通部，不包括特需医疗部、国际医疗部、外宾医疗部、VIP部、干部病房，也不包括康复医院等非约定医疗机构。（2）住院定义：指被保险人因疾病或意外伤害入住医院正式病房进行治疗，并正式办理入出院手续，不包括入住门诊观察室、家庭病床、挂床住院（连续1日无任何治疗，只发生护理费、诊疗费、床位费的视为挂床住院）等不合理住院。（3）住院前后门急诊医疗费用（1.5.2.3）：被保险人因疾病或意外伤害在医院住院治疗，对被保险人在住院前30日内或出院后30日内（含住院和出院当日），因与该次住院治疗相同原因而发生的门诊急诊医疗费用（不含特殊门诊医疗费用及物理治疗、中医理疗等特殊疗法费用），按约定给付保险金。

ins_age_rx_pa1073.title: 平安i药保B款特药费用医疗保险（投保年龄范围与单次处方药量上限条款）
ins_age_rx_pa1073.clause_text: 【原文第7页 6.3–6.4 投保年龄与年龄错误】投保时被保险人的年龄为0周岁至60周岁（0周岁指出生满28日且已健康出院的婴儿）；被保险人真实年龄不符合6.3条约定的投保年龄限制的，我们有权解除合同，并向您退还本合同的现金价值。【原文第3页 1.3.2 恶性肿瘤特种药品费用保险金】每次恶性肿瘤特种药品处方剂量不超过1个月（30日），且须由医院（二级以上公立医院普通部）专科医生开具、属于本合同约定的特种药品目录内且为当前治疗必备的药品。【原文第10页 附录2 指定药店的购药流程】被保险人须在该处方开具医院购买，或在指定药店购买前须经特药服务商药品处方审核通过并提供完整购药凭证；若药品处方审核未通过，我们不承担给付保险金的责任。

independent_zero_shot_schema_compiler_au.description: Uncontaminated zero-shot LLM waiting-period schema field extraction audit across all 17 official waiting-period insurance PDFs (11 confirmation + 6 post-hardening extension), using a fictitious example ID (`example_fictitious_000`) and evaluating `qwen3.8-max`, `kimi-k3`, and `deepseek-v4-pro`.

stage1_explicit_slot_prompting_gain.role: Primary semantic preservation driver on frontier cloud LLMs; eliminates conversational omission of policy titles, elapsed days, and exemption qualifiers.

stage2_output_budget_and_complete_schema.role: Separates genuine LLM generation errors from artificial mid-sentence truncation and incomplete 5-slot rendering.

stage3_zero_call_symbolic_detection_and_.comparison: ordinary_style (naive seed label) -> ordinary_style + zero_call_verifier_dynamic_relabel (0 LLM calls)
stage3_zero_call_symbolic_detection_and_.role: Even without prompt engineering or second-pass LLM calls, symbolic reachability verification detects dropped pivotal conditions and dynamically re-certifies degraded queries to CLARIFY, eliminating single-arm RAG ranking inversion.

stage4_targeted_diagnostic_second_pass_r.panel_majority_usability_note: Ties condition_prompt (161/176 vs 161/176, p=1.0) and generic_self_refine (161/176 vs 163/176, p=0.50) under frontier LLM panel adjudication because panel judges forgive minor surface-alias or date-format variations that strict symbolic extractors flag.
stage4_targeted_diagnostic_second_pass_r.role: Restores determinate scenario coverage (from 82.5%-92.5% under verify_only_filter to 97.5%-100.0%), guarantees strict deterministic slot extractability (98.86%), and repairs residual threshold/title omissions especially on smaller or noisier generators (e.g., Qwen2.5-7B 66.7% -> 95.8%).
